sourceFile: 33. MSU-L20S15-07GMI Report test Find reason NG frequency SPL increase high -  date 09.10.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not safe because it merges separate sheets and many process trials into one ambiguous changed factor with unreliable outcomes.
issues: Changed factor is over-broad and mixes cushion, offset, UV, vendor, bond amount, and dry-time trials.
Baseline/test grouping is wrong; Ralon is treated as baseline though it appears as a tested condition.
Two sheets with different dates/purposes are combined without proving they are one comparable validation context.
Several measurement outcomes are parser artifacts from headers or mixed columns, producing nonsensical stats.
Improvement judgement is over-applied; some comparisons are not materially improved or lack a valid control.
requiredUserQuestions: Are sheets Test and Test (2) intended as one validation report or separate reviews?
What is the intended baseline for the Test (2) function checks?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors by actual tested condition and preserve sheet/date context.
Use Normal on Test!43 only as baseline for comparable Test-sheet trials.
Keep Test (2) trials separate or mark them not_judged if no baseline is confirmed.
Remove header-derived and mixed-column measurement statistics.
Cite only relevant section, condition, and data rows for each outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current grouping and header-derived citations are insufficient for final evidence.
